workspace.title: Contract Costs
workspace.description: Sales commissions held as an asset and amortized over the contract or customer life.
workspace.policyDetail: Amortize over {basis}; practical expedient {expedient}; customer life {life}.
workspace.noPolicy: No policy is in effect. Create one in Setup before capitalizing.

queue.title: Needs attention
queue.emptyDescription: Every commission is linked and every active contract carries a healthy balance. Capitalize a commission to grow the asset.
queue.unlinkedHint: Commission from {date} is not linked to a contract yet.

drawer.linkHint: This commission has no contract yet, so nothing amortizes. Link it to schedule amortization.
drawer.impairHint: The contract churned or shrank. Assess impairment to write the asset down.

capitalize.title: Capitalize a commission
capitalize.description: Record the cost as an asset. Costs the policy excludes, or covered by the one-year expedient, expense immediately instead.
capitalize.preview: Preview: debit the contract cost asset and credit the original expense for {amount} {currency}.

run.title: Run amortization
run.description: Posts one amortization line per due asset in the period. Assets already posted skip; closed periods refuse.

link.title: Link to a contract
link.description: Schedules amortization from the live policy and posts the capitalization journal.

impair.title: Recognize impairment
impair.description: Carrying amount {carrying}. Anything above the remaining consideration less unrecognized costs writes down.
impair.clean: No impairment: the asset is recoverable.

import.title: Import commissions
import.description: One commission per line: {columns}. Amounts post in {currency}. Unknown contracts queue unlinked.
import.failed: Unable to import the commission rows.
import.badShape: Every line needs {columns}, separated by commas.
